lines.en: label norikospring1:
scene nightsky
Somehow or another, I wind up in the second half of town again.
But seeing as I’ve learned my lesson (be it conscious or not) to try and stay away from bridges or overhangs or anything else I can throw myself off of, I now have to figure out something else to do.
But do you know what place doesn’t have any bridges or overhangs? The convenience store.

Unfortunately, there’s a creature with pink hair who practically lives inside of that building that is equally dangerous to me based on nothing but several blackouts and the biases of my deceased girlfriend(?).
And no, I’m obviously not saying that because the creature in question lives her life with a pocketknife tucked into her waistband. I am saying it because it’s true.
scene black
While the pieces of my past may no longer throw this puzzle of a life into potential world-ending turmoil, it doesn’t mean I’m ready to start filling in the blanks.
And something that’s a happy memory for her might be a nightmare for me. Which is why I have to be careful.
I can learn.
I just don’t want to.
: Ah! Onii-chan!
scene norikokonbinifire1
: Onii-chan?
: Not legally or biologically, but somewhat historically. And history dictates that it’s normal for me to call him that while we’re in here!
: Just because you have a history of doing that doesn’t make it “normal.”
: Yeah, it makes it fuckin’ weird and gross.
: I mean...I don’t think I’d go that far.
scene norikokonbinifire2
: Shocker.
: You’re welcome to call me a cute pet-name as well if you’d like, Yumi.
: Sure. Does Captain Rapist work for you or should I figure something else out?
: Figure something else out, please.
scene norikokonbinifire3
: Nicknames aside- you got here at the perfect time, Sensei! I was just about to go on break.
: That’s nice. But Yumi has a track record of shoplifting and probably shouldn’t be left here alone.
: He ain’t wrong.
: Yumi’s fine. She needs money way more than candy and condoms.
: But you and me? We’ve got other stuff to do. Primarily stuff of the “bonding” variety since you now treat me like the middle child and don’t let me love you as much as you used to.
: So is he your brother or your dad? I don’t get this relationship.
scene norikokonbinifire4
: Brother in the streets, daddy in the sheets.
: How do I put in my two-weeks notice? I’ve never done it before.
: You don’t. You’re stuck here forever.
: In more ways than you know.
scene norikokonbinifire5
: Which means that you and I are free!
: From your shift? Sure. From the never-ending cycle of misery that blankets this school year in doubt and misfortune like snow over the Arctic plains? Nope. No one is free from that.
scene norikokonbinifire6
: But you don’t even go to school anymore. Which means you should be more concerned with taking that blanket off of me so we don’t have to conceal our cuddling from anyone we know.
: Hey, before you clock out for break, do you mind if I run to the bathroom and make myself puke really quick?
scene black

: I do, actually. Purging isn’t good for your teeth. Or really anything for that matter. So keep all of that stuff inside you while we get out of your hair! Which looks very beautiful, by the way. Which shampoo do you use?
: Uhh...I ain’t sure. But I hope we’re havin’ another one of those fuckin’ hotel parties soon because I’m running low on whatever it is.
: Are you just...using the sample bottles from the hotels?...
: Beats payin’ for shit, doesn’t it?
: Some may call her cheap. I call her resourceful.
: She’ll look gorgeous as my maid of honor on our wedding day. And save me so much money as well.
: Blch!...Sorry...I’ll be right back!
scene norikokonbinifire7

After Yumi disobeys Noriko’s orders and regurgitates the evidence of her disgust for me into the convenience store bathroom, I grab a beer and head outside with that pink-haired creature I warned you about before.

Her smile stings like antiseptic and the glow of her skin near the fire reminds me less of a certain type of bug and more of a vending machine. But I think that part is kind of beautiful in its own way.
She never leaves because she can’t. And she’ll give me anything I want so long as I press the right button.
When she looks at me, I instinctively look away. I’m not sure if it’s because I’m embarrassed or not when I don’t have anything specific to be embarrassed about, but it certainly feels that way.
I take a sip of my drink, hoping its effects take root long before they’re supposed to because maybe that will be the push I need to stare back at her while her eyes beg for the attention of mine.
scene norikokonbinifire8
But instead, we sit in silence.
Her excitement, like that of a loyal dog, has waned now that I’ve gotten settled in. It was only the initial shock that caused her tail to wag.
I’m sure she’s thinking of what we’re supposed to talk about now. And I hate that she has to do that — but it’s the result of me being a terrible owner.
You see, “settling in” for me is more like taking my clothes off and pulling my knees to my chest in the corner of the room. Of course a dog’s excitement would fade if it had to watch such a thing.
But she’ll figure out what to do and what I need soon enough because she’s the mature one here.
See?
She’s already coming over to lick me.
: So I heard from Nee-chan about her possibly moving in?
: Well, keep it to yourself because Ami hasn’t yet.
: So it’s true then?
: Maybe. I don’t know.
: I’m trying to step up and play the role of a father, but there’s no denying that a mother would probably be better for Ami. And I think Niki fits that role better than anyone.
: Yeah. Guess it wouldn’t make much sense for me to be Ami’s mother figure when we’re almost the same age.
scene norikokonbinifire9
: Can you imagine? Me telling her to clean her room and do the dishes and stuff like that?
: No, but that’s mostly because she already does all of those things without asking.
: Then what would I need to do? Hit me with the job description, Sensei. Maybe I’ll throw my hat in the ring and compete with Nee-chan only to lose for the millionth time?
: Would you even want a role like that in the first place? You’re young. I thought you still wanted to figure out who you are and all that?
scene norikokonbinifire10
: I’m just messing around. As nice as it sounds to have you as my partner in life, I can’t imagine ever seeing Ami as a daughter.
scene norikokonbinifire11
: So I guess maybe I really am screwed if that’s going to be part of the criteria now.
: Oh well. It was a good run. All that’s left to do now is wait for gay marriage to be legalized so I can marry Kirin and open a sex shop or something.
: You’ve got some strong competition in town, Noriko. Don’t think that path will be easy. Maybe take over your parents’ restaurant instead?

: Kirin would look hot in a qipao. But again, this is all just fantasy-talk and not a thing I’m actually considering. Which I need to verbally clarify so you don’t misunderstand and think I’m actually quitting you.
: I never figured you were in the first place. I’m not sure what you’d even do with yourself if you weren’t too busy chasing after me all the time.
: Like I said, just making sure. We don’t need to dwell on the fact that I’m a wannabe brocon any longer than we already have.
: Especially when there’s something I actually want to talk about tonight.
: Oh good. Late night talks always go really well for me.
scene norikokonbinifire12
if amifingered == True:
: You’re one to talk. Because I distinctly remember one of our last late-night talks ending with you telling me that I had to “suffer for you.”
: And you’ve been doing a great job.
: Have I? It doesn’t feel like it.
: That’s how you know you’re doing it well.
else:
: I guess our track record isn’t great when it comes to those, is it?
: My track record in general isn’t great when it comes to those. But it’s not great when it comes to daytime conversations either, so I’m not sure what I’m expecting.
: This one might be a little awkward, Sensei.
: Well, that’s a great thing to hear right before I find out what it is.
if amifingered == True:
: If I’m going to suffer for you...would you mind suffering for me for a little while? Even if it’s just tonight.
else:
: My timing has never been good. Now’s no exception to that.
: What is it then, Noriko?
scene norikokonbinifire13
: We had the Dorm Wars again recently.
: It was a lot of fun...But it felt really different without you. Just like class has felt different with Imani as our teacher and...the dorms without whispers of who you’re with and when.
: There’s a lot that feels like that now. Like this is a...slightly incorrect world that we accidentally fell into when you and Ami left school.
: And I don’t know if I’m the only one who’s noticed or...if everyone is just trying to save face...but sometimes, it feels like a lot of the smaller details go unnoticed by everyone but me.
: Maybe that’s just the type of person I am — someone who looks a little too closely at everything, but...
: See, that’s kind of what I wanted to talk to you about in the first place. To see if maybe I’m just going crazy or...if you’ve noticed something too.
: Well...what are you talking about, exactly?
: I’m talking about Maya.
scene norikokonbinifire14
: Come on...don’t look at me like that. You make me talk about stuff I’m not 100%% comfortable with all the time. Can’t you bear with me for a second just to hear me out?
scene norikokonbinifire15
: Yeah, sorry. That just...took me by surprise.
: You’re still seeing her outside of school, right? Because the last thing she said to me was actually during the Dorm Wars and it was about going to look for you.
: She bailed on the whole competition to do that. And while that part of her isn’t something I’d call unusual...everything else kind of has been.
scene norikokonbinifire16
: Maya and I...haven’t made as much progress as I would have liked since I transferred in. But we at least made something.
: Things changed a little bit. That...one-sided resentment she has for me never faded, but I could feel her starting to, like...I don’t know...resign herself maybe?
: Kind of like a...“you stay on your side of the line and I’ll stay on mine” type of situation, but...
: I mean, I guess that isn’t entirely accurate either since that’s why she still hates me in the first place. I think. I don’t know.
: She’s always hated me and I’ve never really understood why. But the point is that I felt like her hatred was starting to fade and...
scene norikokonbinifire17
: Out of nowhere, it’s gone right back to how it was when I first transferred in.
: So I was wondering if you’ve also noticed anything or...if I really am just going crazy.
scene norikokonbinifire18
: She is different...
: Right?! I fucking knew it! But everyone I’ve tried talking to about it has been all like, “Really? She seems the same to me.” And I’m just over here like ppfhfbfbfhfbttt?!?!! Are you BLIND?!
: Talk to Ayane...she’ll agree with you...

: She’s noticed it too, then? Well, what is it? If you can tell me, I mean. If it’s something personal, I probably shouldn’t pry. It was just weird to me that she started being so...well, weird all of a sudden and-
scene norikokonbinifire19
: Noriko, I...
: I don’t know how to talk to you about this.
: And it’s probably going to make me sound insane, but I’m beginning to wonder if I am insane and so...maybe that’s not really the worst thing possible.
: Tell me anything you’re comfortable with and not a word more. I’m not trying to play detective here, I just want an idea of what’s going on so I know how to approach her.
: Noriko...that person I talked about when I came back to school...the one I lost...
: I was talking about her.
scene norikokonbinifire20
: I do still see her outside of school sometimes, but it’s more like I’m seeing her reflection. Or someone walking around in her skin while the real her is just...gone.
: Like everything we've seen and felt together over the last few years is just...
: It's just...not her...
: Is this...
: Is this anything like that memory thing that happened to you?...
scene norikokonbinifire21

: It’s exactly like that. The same thing that happened to me happened to her. But I’m not sure if I can word it any differently than that without causing your brain to start instinctively interrupting me and-
: But, Sensei...
: If it’s the same thing that happened to you, doesn’t that mean she’s still in there somewhere?
scene norikokonbinifire22
: Like...I don’t really get how it works, but you’re getting your memories back little by little, aren’t you?
: Well...yeah...
: But...
scene norikokonbinifire23
: No...No, it’s not the same thing that happened to me then...
: But how do you know that?
: It’s not like you can read her mind, can you? And, if you can, could you maybe let me know why she refuses to be my friend when everyone around her is just as guilty of loving you as I am?
: If that’s...
: If that’s really how it is...
: If that’s really how it is, you’ll finally get to experience what Nee-chan and I have been going through these last...
scene norikokonbinifire24
: Last few...
: Years?...
scene norikokonbinifire25
: A...Anyway! I know just how scary the thought of someone losing precious memories can be, but I also know now that it’s possible to get them back!
scene norikokonbinifire26
: And that’s an adventure all on its own.
: It might be hard...and the road might be bumpy...
: But the scenery when you get there, Sensei?...
scene black
: You’ll see such beautiful things...
Noriko’s break comes to an end a few minutes later and she heads back inside to take over for Yumi.
But I stay out here.
I’m not sure if I can walk right now.
And I know that Noriko would be more than happy to stay with me, but she knows me. So she knows I want to be alone.
But the worst part is that I didn’t even have it in me to thank her for giving me the first taste of hope I’ve had since she vanished.
Is it really possible that she’s actually in there?...
And if so...how do I get her back?
Do I just do what she did and...ignore her until she figures it out herself?
What happens if I break her again?...
Will I see the same things she saw when she broke me?...
I don’t know...
I have no idea...
$ norikospring1 = True
$ noriko_love += 1
Noriko’s affection increases to [noriko_love], but you’re too busy thinking about another girl to care!
This always happens to her! You should take this moment as a sign to spend more time with her and then eventually have sex with her because she deserves it!
Also, she is wrong! Do not have hope! Do not pass Go! Do not collect $200!
Go home, cum in a sock, then forget this ever happened!
Goodnight!
